# Not Just a Car

> [Not Just a Car](https://notjustacar.com) is an independent car-culture magazine and hub delivering **opinion pieces**, **news**, **hands-on guides**, a growing **community forum & classifieds (beta)**, curated **driver deals**, and a suite of **interactive tools** for enthusiasts who actually put miles on their cars.

Important notes:

- Core pillars: **Car-culture content**, **practical DIY guides**, **interactive calculators**, **curated deals**, and a **forum-driven community**.  
- **6 performance calculators** + **1 savings tool**: torque to HP, WHP to HP, power-to-weight ratio, PSI to bar, boost to HP, EV savings.  
- Community touch-points: **Forum** (builds, classifieds beta), **Newsletter** for new stories & deals.
